hero.headline: DPU-COL Online MBA in Human Resource Management: Syllabus, Fees and Career Outcomes
hero.sub: NAAC A++ | NIRF University #41 | UGC-DEB Approved

sections.tldr: DPU-COL Online MBA in Human Resource Management covers manpower planning, compensation management, performance and potential management, labour laws, training and development, organisational design, development and change, strategic HR, and HR audit. NAAC A++ NIRF University #41.

about.body:
Semester 3 has seven subjects (compared to four in most DPU specs) including a Generic Elective option. This deeper curriculum coverage is notable: manpower planning, compensation management, performance and potential management, labour laws, training and development, and organisational design are each standalone subjects rather than modules within a combined course. Semester 4 adds strategic HR, HR audit, another Generic Elective, and project work.

EdifyEdu verifies data independently and takes no commission from any university.

subjects.name: Manpower Planning
subjects.description: Workforce demand and supply forecasting, skills inventory analysis, succession planning frameworks, headcount modelling, and HR planning integration with business strategy.

subjects.name: Compensation Management
subjects.description: Job evaluation methods (point-factor, ranking), pay structure design, variable pay and incentive frameworks, statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity), and benefits benchmarking.

subjects.name: Performance & Potential Management
subjects.description: Performance appraisal systems (360-degree, MBO, balanced scorecard), potential assessment frameworks, PIP (performance improvement plan) design, and talent review process.

subjects.name: Labour Laws
subjects.description: Industrial Disputes Act, Factories Act, Payment of Wages Act, PF and ESI Acts, Shops and Establishments Act, and new labour code overview (Code on Wages, Industrial Relations Code).

subjects.name: Training & Development
subjects.description: Training needs analysis, learning programme design, e-learning and blended learning approaches, ROI of training evaluation (Kirkpatrick model), and leadership development programmes.

subjects.name: Elective: Digital Marketing or Business English
Strategic HR
subjects.description: HR strategy alignment with business goals, HR scorecard design, employer branding, talent management strategy, and HR transformation roadmaps.

subjects.name: HR Audit
subjects.description: HR audit methodology, compliance audit checklist, HR process effectiveness assessment, attrition analysis, and HR analytics for audit reporting.

subjects.name: Elective: Soft Skills or Business Ethics & Corporate Governance
Project Work Report
subjects.description: Industry-linked HR project. Typically a compensation benchmarking study, attrition analysis, HR audit, or training effectiveness evaluation.

whoHires.body:
**Industries:** IT services, manufacturing, banking and financial services, healthcare, FMCG, retail, consulting (HR advisory), and government enterprises

**Entry-level roles:** HR Executive, Recruitment Executive, Compensation and Benefits Analyst, Training Coordinator, Labour Welfare Officer, HR Operations Executive

**Mid-level roles:** HR Manager, Talent Acquisition Manager, Compensation Manager, HR Business Partner, Learning and Development Manager, Employee Relations Manager

**Senior roles:** HR Director, Chief People Officer, VP HR, Head of Talent Management, CHRO (mid-market), Head of HR Operations

Online batches are often reported apart from campus ones, or not at all. edifyedu.in does not publish employer lists it cannot source. Treat the roles above as the kinds of jobs this syllabus prepares you for, not as a list of who has hired from this batch.

skills.body:
The Human Resource Management specialisation builds skills across the full HR lifecycle:

- Compensation Design: job evaluation methodology, pay band construction, variable pay structure (sales incentive, ESOPs), and statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, professional tax)
- Labour Law: Industrial Disputes Act interpretation, standing orders compliance, new labour code (Code on Wages 2019) implementation roadmap, and statutory filing
- HR Analytics: attrition rate calculation, cost-per-hire tracking, time-to-fill benchmarking, employee engagement score analysis, and HR dashboard design
- Performance Management: goal-setting frameworks (OKR, KRA), appraisal calibration process, talent review and succession planning grid, and PIP documentation

- Training and Development: TNA methodology, learning path design, e-learning content evaluation, and ROI calculation for training programmes
- HR Audit: compliance checklist design, HR process maturity assessment, and attrition root cause analysis

**Soft skills:** Handling employee grievances and disciplinary actions, presenting HR strategy to the board, facilitating change management initiatives, negotiating with labour unions, and managing sensitive employee relations cases.

certificate.body:
Graduates receive an MBA degree certificate with Human Resource Management as the specialisation, issued by Dr. D.Y. Patil Vidyapeeth, Pune (DPU-COL) under UGC-DEB 2020 online mode standards.

The degree carries NAAC A++ accreditation and NIRF University #41. It is valid for government HR officer recruitment, PSU HR positions, banking HR promotions, and private-sector HR management roles. edX certifications supplement the credential. DigiLocker issuance is standard.

faqs.question: How many subjects does the HRM specialisation have compared to other DPU specs?
faqs.answer: The HRM spec has seven subjects in Semester 3 and four in Semester 4 (including project work and generic elective). Most other DPU specialisations have four Sem 3 subjects and three Sem 4 subjects.

faqs.question: Does the programme cover new Indian labour codes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates in compliance roles will find this dual coverage directly applicable during the labour code transition period.

faqs.question: Is DPU HRM valid for government HR officer and PSU recruitment?
faqs.answer: Yes. DPU-COL's MBA is UGC-DEB approved from a NAAC A++ NIRF University #41. It satisfies the MBA requirement for government HR officer recruitment (Group B), PSU HR management trainee positions, and banking HR promotions.
